# Nets Unlimited, Inc.

> Nets Unlimited designs, fabricates and installs custom rope, cable and netting systems for commercial, recreational and zoological environments.

Nets Unlimited, Inc. is a licensed, bonded and insured netting specialist (Arizona ROC #236070) founded in 2004 and based in Phoenix, Arizona. The company serves clients across the United States, from early concept and drawings through fabrication, installation, inspection and maintenance.

## Company

- [Home](https://netsunlimited.com/): overview of applications, services and frequently asked questions
- [Services](https://netsunlimited.com/services/): planning and consultation, custom fabrication, installation, inspection and maintenance
- [About](https://netsunlimited.com/about/): company history, team and credentials
- [Contact and quote requests](https://netsunlimited.com/contact/): phone, email, address, hours and the quote form
- [Privacy policy](https://netsunlimited.com/privacy/)

## Applications

- [Zoo and aquarium netting](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/zoo/): new exhibits, refurbishment and animal enrichment
- [Waterpark and theme park netting](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/waterpark/): barriers, handrails, slide covers and dry play
- [Rope bridges and tunnels](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/bridge/): stationary, suspension, V-bridge and tunnel systems
- [Rope and cable handrails](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/handrail/): rope, knotted netting, cable and hand-woven stainless steel
- [Rope play systems](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/play/): climbing nets, tunnels, spiderwebs and play elements
- [Golf and sports netting](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/sport/): golf, court and sports containment
- [Safety and fall protection netting](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/protect/): fall, debris and secondary-barrier netting
- [Architectural rope and net decor](https://netsunlimited.com/applications/decorate/): themed and decorative installations
